svg.text: A free browser game and a portable arcade booth for road safety.
Wait at the kerb. Look both ways. Cross on the green man. Check your phone after you cross.
Play now: driftsprits-stack.github.io/kerb-sense Stop somewhere safe before you play.
Booth designed in Blender by Justin Chua Ming En, to be built during the funded programme.
Delta Challenge 2026 / Track B: Road Safety Education / Young ChangeMakers grant requested
TEAM if raeann cared / Yishun Innova Junior College / Singapore Polytechnic / Ngee Ann Polytechnic
